name: spectral_s1b_replication
status: proposed design; no seed drawn; seed base locked until review
execution_order: round-robin over i_rep across all sizes and families
seed_rule: np.random.SeedSequence([seed_base, i_family, i_size, i_rep]) with PCG64; sources from a child of the same sequence (as S1)
controls: S1 v0.2 P0a-P0d unchanged, STOP gates

outcomes.cayley_uniform_tree: D = slope(2^18) - slope(2^16); REPLICATED if 90% Welch CI > 0; EQUIVALENT if CI inside [-0.03, 0.03]; else UNDETERMINED
outcomes.ust_2d_torus: D = slope(256) - slope(128); EQUIVALENT if 90% CI inside [-0.03, 0.03]; else NOT-SHOWN
outcomes.reliability: UNRELIABLE for a family if jackknife SE > 1.25 x delta-method SE
